objective: Ensure 100% synchronization between site, database, and CMS while implementing booking flow improvements and fixing admin panel regressions

phase_1_zero_drift_verification.name: Complete System Synchronization Audit
phase_1_zero_drift_verification.description: Verify and fix any drift between frontend site, database schema, and CMS content

tasks.name: Database Schema Audit
tasks.description: Verify all database tables match expected schema and CMS requirements
steps: Query all tables: bookings, clients, rooms, surf_camps, homepage_content, navigation_items, experiences, pages
Verify column types match TypeScript interfaces
Check for missing indexes, foreign keys, and constraints
Verify RLS policies are correctly configured
Document any schema drift found
tasks.validation: All tables exist with correct schema, indexes, and RLS policies

tasks.name: CMS Content Synchronization
tasks.description: Ensure all CMS content is properly stored and retrievable
steps: Verify homepage_content table has all required sections (hero, surf-weeks, about, rooms, reviews, facilities)
Check JSONB columns contain valid JSON
Verify image URLs in CMS point to valid Supabase Storage paths
Test API endpoints: GET /api/admin/homepage, POST, PUT, DELETE
Verify CMS changes reflect immediately on homepage
tasks.validation: All CMS content loads correctly, CRUD operations work, changes reflect on site

tasks.name: Frontend-Database Mapping Verification
tasks.description: Ensure all frontend components correctly fetch and display database data
steps: Verify BookingWidget fetches rooms from database (not hardcoded)
Verify SurfWeeksTable fetches surf_camps from database
Verify homepage sections fetch from homepage_content table
Check all API routes use correct Supabase queries
Verify no hardcoded data remains in components
tasks.validation: Zero hardcoded data, all content from database

tasks.name: State Management Consistency
tasks.description: Verify booking flow state matches database structure
steps: Review BookingState interface matches database booking structure
Verify participantNames array structure matches database
Check roomAssignments structure matches room_assignments table
Verify guestDetails structure matches clients table
Test state persistence across booking steps
tasks.validation: State structure matches database, data flows correctly through steps

phase_2_booking_flow_step2.name: Dynamic Participant Name Inputs (Step 2)
phase_2_booking_flow_step2.description: Add dynamic name input fields that appear when participant quantity is selected

current_state.issue: Step 2 only collects participant count, not individual names
current_state.current_behavior: User selects quantity (1-3), but names are not collected until Step 4

required_changes.name: Add Dynamic Name Input Fields
required_changes.location: Inside the 'Number of Guests' card, below the counter controls
implementation: Add input fields that dynamically render based on state.guests value
Fields should appear immediately when guest count changes
Each field should have label: 'Participant {index} Name' (e.g., 'Participant 1 Name')
Use existing participantNames state array
Sync local state with global state.participantNames
Fields should be required and validate before allowing Next

required_changes.name: Update State Management
required_changes.description: Ensure SET_PARTICIPANT_NAMES action properly updates state
required_changes.validation: When guest count changes, participantNames array updates correctly

required_changes.name: Add Validation
required_changes.description: Prevent proceeding to next step if name fields are empty
implementation: Disable 'Next' button if any participant name is empty
Show validation error messages for empty fields
Highlight empty fields with red border

required_changes.name: Update Data Structure
required_changes.description: Change from simple count to array of participant objects
required_changes.validation: State contains array of ParticipantName objects with firstName

acceptance_criteria: When user selects 1 participant, 1 name input field appears
When user increments to 3, 3 name input fields appear
When user decrements, excess fields are removed from bottom
Next button is disabled if any name field is empty
Names are stored in state.participantNames array
UI matches existing rounded corner style

phase_3_booking_flow_step3.name: Room Assignment via Participant Tags (Step 3)
phase_3_booking_flow_step3.description: Enable assigning specific participants to specific rooms using tag/chip selection

current_state.issue: Room assignment uses generic guest IDs, not participant names
current_state.current_behavior: Guests assigned by ID (guest-1, guest-2), not by name

required_changes.name: Display Participant Names as Tags
required_changes.location: Inside each Room Card, below description/amenities, above price/add button
implementation: Add section: 'Assign Guests to this Room:'
Display participant names from state.participantNames as clickable tags/chips
Unselected state: outline style or greyed out
Selected state: solid orange color (brand orange) indicating assignment
Tags should show participant firstName from Step 2

required_changes.name: Implement Capacity Limits
implementation: Check room.maxOccupancy before allowing assignment
If room has 'Up to 1 guest', only allow 1 tag selection
If room has 'Up to 6 guests', allow multiple selections
Show warning or auto-deselect if capacity exceeded
Disable tags when room is full
required_changes.validation: Cannot assign more guests than room capacity

required_changes.name: Implement Exclusivity Logic
required_changes.description: Ensure participant cannot be in two rooms simultaneously
implementation: When participant tag is clicked in Room A, remove them from Room B if assigned
OR: Disable/hide tag in Room B if already assigned to Room A
Update state.roomAssignments to reflect single-room assignment
Show visual feedback when participant is moved between rooms
required_changes.validation: Each participant assigned to exactly one room

required_changes.name: Update Room Assignment Data Structure
required_changes.description: Store participant names in room assignments
required_changes.new: RoomAssignment: {roomId, participantNames: ['John', 'Sarah']} OR keep guestIds but map to names
implementation: Map guestIds to participantNames when displaying
Ensure assignment uses participant IDs that match participantNames array

required_changes.name: Add Visual Feedback
required_changes.description: Show room full state and assignment status
implementation: Visual indicator when room reaches max capacity (e.g., red counter, disabled add button)
Highlight assigned participants in orange
Show unassigned guests list at top
Update price calculation based on assigned guests

acceptance_criteria: Participant names from Step 2 appear as tags in each room card
Clicking a tag assigns participant to that room
Room capacity limits are strictly enforced
Participant cannot be in two rooms at once
Price calculation updates based on room assignments

phase_4_booking_flow_step4.name: Pre-fill Guest Details (Step 4)
phase_4_booking_flow_step4.description: Initialize First Name fields with data from Step 2

current_state.issue: First Name fields are empty even if names were entered in Step 2
current_state.current_behavior: User must re-enter names in Step 4

required_changes.name: Pre-fill First Name Fields
implementation: In useEffect that initializes guestForms, check state.participantNames
Pre-fill firstName: existingGuest?.firstName || participantName?.firstName || ''
Priority: existingGuest > participantName > empty
Ensure all guests from Step 2 have their names pre-filled
Keep fields editable so user can correct typos

code_reference.existing_logic: lines 32-64 in GuestDetails.tsx already has this logic!

required_changes.name: Bi-directional Sync (Optional Enhancement)
required_changes.description: If user edits name in Step 4, update global state
implementation: When firstName is edited, update state.participantNames
If user goes back to Step 3, tags show corrected names
Update state when form field changes

required_changes.name: Validation Enhancement
required_changes.description: Mark pre-filled First Name as valid immediately
implementation: If firstName is pre-filled from participantNames, mark field as valid
Show green checkmark or no error state
User still needs to enter Last Name, Email, Phone

acceptance_criteria: First Name fields show values from Step 2 on page load
Pre-filled fields are marked as valid
If names edited in Step 4, they update in Step 3 if user goes back
phase_4_booking_flow_step4.note: Code review shows GuestDetails.tsx lines 38-52 already implement pre-filling! Verify it works correctly.

steps: Step 1: Select 'Room' experience
Step 2: Select dates, set guests to 3, enter names: ['John', 'Sarah', 'Mike']
Step 3: Assign John to Room A, Sarah to Room B, Mike to Room C
Step 4: Verify names pre-filled, complete remaining fields
Step 5: Review and submit
Verify: Database contains booking with correct participant names and room assignments
Step 1: Select 'Surf Week' experience
Step 2: Select surf week, set participants to 2, enter names
Step 3: Select room for surf week
Step 4: Verify names pre-filled
Step 5: Review and submit
Verify: Database contains surf camp enrollment with participant names
Enter names in Step 2
Proceed to Step 3, verify names appear in tags
Go back to Step 2, change a name
Proceed to Step 3, verify updated name appears
Proceed to Step 4, verify updated name pre-filled

Verify room_assignments table links guests to rooms correctly
Check clients table has participant details
Verify surf_camp_enrollments table has participant names

Test CMS content updates reflect on site
